mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM om_enum_type enum_type INNER JOIN om_ai_task task ON task.workspace_id = enum_type.workspace_id AND task.version_id = enum_type.version_id WHERE task.id = #{taskId} AND enum_type.enum_type = #{enumType} AND enum_type.del_flag = 0
SELECT enum_name AS enumName, enum_type AS enumType, 'PROJECT' AS enumSource FROM om_enum_type WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND status = '0' AND del_flag = 0
